_doctrine: PATTERN DNA — each tradition's shader carries a GENOME (g_scale repeat density, g_weight motif thickness/size, g_wobble jitter amplitude, g_tint palette cast). A variant is a gene setting; the canonical genes (all 1.0) reproduce the tradition's reference look. Sweep variants per the props-DNA convention: fine / canonical / bold. Capture with commons/testing/capture_pattern_dna.gd.

g_scale.means: repeat density — how fine the weave/tiling runs

g_weight.means: motif thickness / size — the hand's pressure

g_wobble.means: jitter amplitude — the dye's blur, the binding's unevenness, the human wobble

g_tint.means: palette cast multiplied over the tradition's colours

fine.note: the fine cloth — tight repeat, light hand

canonical.note: the reference look — the atlas plate

bold.note: the festival bolt — big motifs, heavy hand, live wobble
